user.title: Govee LAN
user.description:
This will scan your local network for Govee lights.

Before continuing, enable **LAN Control** for each device in the Govee Home app (device settings).

If multicast is blocked (VLANs, guest Wi-Fi…), enter your devices' IP addresses below.

error.no_devices_found: No Govee device found. Make sure "LAN Control" is enabled in the Govee Home app and the device is powered on, on the same network.
error.port_in_use: UDP port 4002 is already in use by another program (another Govee integration, govee2mqtt…).
